sentence: Kirkelligence that leaves you frine needs no encore.

wombos.definition: A sharp, Kirk-coded form of intelligence — the kind of wit and awareness that carries an effortlessly cool energy.
wombos.example: You could tell by the way he handled it — pure Kirkelligence.

wombos.definition: A breathless, fried state of laughter — so amused you're basically crying. One level up from just being "fine."
wombos.example: The blooper reel had me full-on frine — I couldn't breathe.
